Create a managed macOS VM.

```text
pomme create [FLAGS] [NAME]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name for direct creation. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--config CONFIG` | Create VMs from a JSON, YAML, TOML, or Pkl config. |
| `--version VERSION` | macOS version, build, or `latest`. |
| `--latest` | Use the latest signed macOS version. Same as `--version latest`. |
| `--restore-image RESTORE_IMAGE` | Local IPSW path. Available only in direct mode. |
| `--from-template FROM_TEMPLATE` | Clone an installed template (see `pomme template`) instead of restoring an IPSW. |
| `--ipsw-device IPSW_DEVICE` | Apple silicon Mac identifier used to resolve `--version`. |
| `--disk-size DISK_SIZE` | Virtual disk size. Default: `60GB`. |
| `--memory MEMORY` | Guest memory size. Default: `8GB`. |
| `--boot BOOT` | State after creation: normal (default), recovery, or none. Values: `none`, `normal`, `recovery`. Default: `normal`. |
| `--recovery` | Leave the VM booted in Recovery after creation. Same as `--boot recovery`. |
| `--shutdown` | Shut the VM down after the agent is installed and verified. Same as `--boot none`. |
| `--dry-run` | Resolve and print the creation plan without creating VMs. |
| `--resume` | Resume the durable Pomme agent workflow for this VM. |
| `--parallel` | Create config members two at a time instead of one after another. Virtualization allows at most two macOS guests, so the flag takes no count. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
